# LGD Demo Organization (lgd-demo-organization)

> A publicly verifiable demonstration organization run under the LGD three-law constitution (Registry, Evidence, Gates). Every external claim is backed by independent evaluator reports, reproducible tooling, and external institutional time-stamps — no self-certification.

This repository is the verifiable sample, not a product. An outside reader can re-run the archived verification script and compare the printed numbers against the archived reports, without trusting the operator.

## Core

- [README.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/README.md): project description, quick start, bilingual EN / 中文
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/AGENTS.md): the three-law constitution and change-trace rules
- [verify/run_verify.py](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/verify/run_verify.py): one-click outsider verification (Python standard library only)
- [verify/HOW_TO_VERIFY.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/verify/HOW_TO_VERIFY.md): step-by-step verification guide

## Reference

- [registry/skills.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/registry/skills.md): public skill registry, 113 entries (SK-001..SK-113), index only
- [evidence/evaluations/](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/tree/master/evidence/evaluations): independent evaluation reports (outsider perspective)
- [evidence/reverification/](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/tree/master/evidence/reverification): second-round reverification logs
- [gates/badges.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/gates/badges.md): badge issuance register, only entries backed by evidence files

## Optional

- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/SECURITY.md): security policy mapped to the three laws
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): change-trace and evidence requirements
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-demo-organization/blob/master/llms-full.txt): full text for long-context models
